_readme: Refined website copy. Positioning: modern, convenient, personal chiropractic care designed around busy lives. Working professionals are a natural audience, but the messaging is intentionally broad enough to include pain from sport, family life, sleep, repetitive activity and everyday life.

hero.eyebrow: Hi, I'm Tom, your chiropractor in Loughborough
hero.heading: Get out of pain and back to what you enjoy.
hero.lead: Neck, back, shoulder or joint pain? Get expert, personal care without the hassle. Book online in under a minute, park 30 seconds away, and see the same chiropractor from your first appointment to your last, with evening and Saturday appointments available.
hero.note: New here? Your first appointment is a 60-minute consultation, with treatment where appropriate.

why.heading: A simpler, more personal approach to chiropractic.
why.quote: I'll make getting the right care as straightforward as possible, and I'll only recommend what I believe you need.
why.bio: I trained at the Welsh Institute of Chiropractic, graduating in 2021. I spent my first year practicing in Cornwall, then four years at Health on Hand in Leicester and Mansfield, before opening my own clinic here in Loughborough. I live locally myself, and outside the clinic you'll usually find me on a dog walk, out on the golf course (with more enthusiasm than skill), or catching up with friends.

whatITreat.heading: Care for the aches, pains and injuries that get in the way.
whatITreat.note: Pain can come from work, sport, parenting, poor sleep, stress, repetitive movement or simply everyday life. Not sure if chiropractic is right for you? I'll tell you honestly, including when another professional is the better choice.

cards.label: Initial consultation
cards.description: A 60-minute assessment to understand your problem, explain what's going on, how many sessions I would recommend and treatment where appropriate.

cards.label: Follow-up treatment
cards.description: Focused follow-up appointments based on your individual plan and how you're progressing with regular reassessments to understand your improvement.

questions.a: A chiropractor is a regulated healthcare professional who assesses and treats problems affecting the muscles, joints, nerves and spine. Treatment can include hands-on techniques, movement advice, education and exercises.

Both can help with musculoskeletal pain, and there is overlap between the two. My approach combines hands-on treatment with advice and exercises. If I think a physio, GP or another professional would be more appropriate, I'll tell you and help point you in the right direction.
Yes. Chiropractors in the UK must be registered with the General Chiropractic Council. I'm fully registered and trained at the Welsh Institute of Chiropractic.

questions.q: Who will I see at my appointments?
questions.a: You'll see me, Tom, every time. In five years of treating patients I've learned it's just as important to understand the person as the pain, so I focus on finding the root cause rather than just easing symptoms, and I'm with you for every step of your recovery, not just the first visit.

findMe.heading: Your chiropractor in central Loughborough.
findMe.description: You'll find me at The Work Lounge on Beehive Lane, right in the centre of Loughborough. The clinic is on the ground floor, with convenient parking just a short walk away.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: Beehive Lane Car Park is just opposite the clinic, around a 30-second walk.
